meaning: A computer tool that makes a brand-new picture from words you type, such as "a red boat on a lake."
clues: It produces a picture for you.
You do not need a camera to get the picture.
You describe what you want in words, and it makes a brand-new picture.
The more detail you give, the closer the result is to what you imagined.
It has two words. The first starts with I and the second starts with G.
assumes: A photo editor changes a photo you already have
A scanner copies paper into a computer
A printer puts a file on paper

decoys.meaning: An app that changes a photo you already have, such as cropping it or fixing the colors.
A machine that copies a paper page or photo into a computer file.
A machine that puts words or pictures from a computer onto paper.

exchange.speaker: floyd
exchange.text: Back in my day, a picture meant a camera, film, and a week of waiting at the shop.

exchange.speaker: bud
exchange.text: Now a few typed words will do. Tip: tools like this can make fake scenes, so look closely before you trust a picture.

blank.sentence: I typed 'a red boat on a lake' and the ___ made a brand-new picture.

why: It turns words you type into a brand-new picture.
short: Tool that makes pictures from words
